verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET. Per the docs, they offer type-hinted interfaces and abstractions and automate request signing for Payments POST requests. Official signing libraries are also published on GitHub. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence of SDK coverage beyond the Payments API (e.g. Data/Verification APIs).
